briefing.headline: Soft landing intact as inflation moderates and jobs stay firm.

quotable_numbers.sentence: Core CPI at 2.56 percent for Sep 2026 sits above the Fed's target, though the momentum is slowing.
Unemployment at 4.1 percent for Oct 2026 keeps the labor market resilient enough to absorb that price pressure.

briefing.whats_new: Today: 10-Year Treasury lower, from 5.07 percent to 5.04 percent.
